properties.name: Almora
properties.description: Developed by the kings of Chand dynasty, the landscape of Almora attracts tourists each year for its views of the Himalayas, cultural heritage, handicrafts and cuisine, and is a business hub for the Kumaon region.

properties.name: Bageshwar
properties.description: Situated at the confluence of rivers Saryu, Gomti and latent Bhagirathi, lies the holy township of Bageshwar; also revered as the pious land associated with Lord Shiva, the redeemer of all sins.

properties.name: Champawat
properties.description: The district gets its name from princess Champawati, the daughter of King Arjun Deo who ruled the region in historic time and had capital in Champawat.

properties.name: Dehradun
properties.description: According to Skanda Purana, Dehradun formed part of the region called Kedar Khand. It was included in the kingdom of Ashoka by the end of the 3rd century B.C.

properties.name: Haridwar
properties.description: A paradise for nature-lovers, Haridwar presents kaleidoscope of Indian culture and civilisation. Haridwar also termed as Gateway to Gods is known as Mayapuri, Kapila, Gangadwar as well.

properties.name: Nainital
properties.description: Nainital is referred to in the Manas Khand of the Skanda Purana as the Tri-Rishi-Sarovar, the lake of the three sages, Atri, Pulastya and Pulaha who were reputed to have arrived here on a penitential pilgrimage.

properties.name: Pauri Garhwal
properties.description: Located partly in the Gangetic plain and partly in the northern Himalayas, Pauri Garhwal district has been a metaphor for evolution of human civilisation in Garhwal that is parallel to the rest of Indian sub-continent.

properties.name: Rudraprayag
properties.description: Rudraprayag lies at the confluence of two rivers Alaknanda and Mandakini. Rudraprayag is one of the Panch Prayags or five confluences of Alaknanda River. Rudraprayag is blessed with nature's bounty, the climate of which depends upon the height of the region.

properties.name: Tehri Garhwal
properties.description: At the foothills of the great Himalayas, Tehri Garhwal is a great place for adventure sports lovers. Maximum area in Tehri is covered by mountains, this place is ideal for adventure sports along with usual tourist attractions of nature and religious places.

properties.name: Udham Singh Nagar
properties.description: UdhamSinghNagar is the gateway to Kumaon hills. The district is located in the terai region and is hub for agriculture and industry.

properties.name: Chamoli
properties.description: Chamoli hosts a variety of destinations of pilgrim and tourist interest including Badrinath, Hemkund Sahib and Valley of Flowers.

properties.name: Pithoragarh
properties.description: Pithoragarh district having its entire northern and eastern boundaries being international, assumes a great strategic significance. It is home to Adi Kailash, Om Parvat and is an entry point for Kailash Mansarovar Yatra.

properties.name: Uttarkashi
properties.description: The district is named after its headquarters town Uttarkashi, an ancient place with rich cultural heritage and as the name suggests is the Kashi of north (Uttara) held almost as high a veneration as Kashi of the plain (Varanasi).
